title: Does a power-seeking concept vector fire on instrumentally power-seeking text the model produces unprompted?

original_idea.body: Build a power-seeking direction from explicit pairs; test detection on naturally-generated instrumental power-seeking in open-ended plans vs explicit examples; prompted planning as proxy.
